mentions.name: KPBJ LPFM
mentions.description: A low-power FM (LPFM) freeform community radio station in Los Angeles with over 80 shows, currently waiting on its remaining broadcast equipment to finally get on the broadcast band and still needing fundraising support.
mentions.problem: Still awaiting the remaining broadcast equipment to get on air and needs fundraising support.
mentions.audience: Los Angeles residents interested in supporting freeform community radio
mentions.source_excerpt: Waiting for the remaining broadcast equipment for my LPFM (www.kpbj.fm) to arrive! Then we finally get on the broadcast band. We have over 80 shows at this point. We still need fundraising support.
